plan.title: feat(scope): scope:complete requires typed evidence or disposition per acceptance criterion

narratives.Description: scope:complete can advance acceptance items to complete without typed per-item evidence. Merge ancestry alone can overstate deploy, smoke, or UAT readiness. Epic #3237 Q3 locked evidence kinds and dispositions for fail-closed completion.
narratives.UserStory: As an operator, I want scope:complete to require typed evidence or a human disposition per acceptance criterion, so that merge ancestry alone cannot claim smoke or UAT complete.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Change the scope:complete path under packages/core/src/scope (and any shared lifecycle helpers) so each acceptance criterion requires either an evidence record (kind test|review|merge|deploy|smoke|uat|observed_behavior plus pointer) or a disposition (waived|deferred|not_applicable with human-origin provenance). Reject kind=merge alone for smoke/UAT/deploy/observed_behavior criteria. Add tests in packages/core/src/scope. Run vitest and task check. Cite #3240 in CHANGELOG.md.
narratives.Overview: feat(scope): scope:complete requires typed evidence or disposition per acceptance criterion
narratives.NonGoals: Out of issue scope; see epic #3237 current-shape.
narratives.AcceptanceJustification: Acceptance items from locked epic contracts.

narrative.Acceptance: Given pending acceptance criteria with no evidence or disposition, when scope:complete runs, it exits non-zero and lists missing criteria.
Given a criterion requiring smoke with only kind=merge evidence, when scope:complete runs, it exits non-zero.
Given a waived disposition with human-origin provenance on a criterion, when scope:complete runs, that criterion may complete without full evidence.
Given CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased], when the PR lands, it cites #3240.

verify_commands: pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/src/scope packages/core/src/lifecycle
swarm.acceptance_criteria_justification: Items map to locked contracts / issue AC.
